The '''Chibias concert hall''' was a concert hall located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chibias/Legends|Chibias]].

==History==
Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Director of [[Offworld Special Events]] [[Litassa Colay]] organized a concert of the famous [[Coruscant Full Symphony]] there.<ref name="Handoff" />

During the concert, [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] stole her ID [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]]. She used her name as an alias to rescue [[Zakarisz Ghent]] who had been arrested by two [[Security officer/Legends|security officers]], [[Jayx]] and [[Tomin]], following the orders of Counselor [[Markko|Raines]].<ref name="Handoff" />
